name: @corbits-builder/add-feature
description: Adds a feature to an existing app: revised requirements and build plan the person approves, then the change.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The project already has an app and the person wants a new feature or a substantial change to what it does.
builder.unless: The project has no app yet, which is build-web-app, or the change is small and stated exactly, such as a font, a colour, a label or a bug fix; start coder change directly.
examples: add a login page to my app
I want users to be able to save favourites
can we add a way to export the list as a spreadsheet
the app needs a payments step at checkout
